page_timing.layout.pop_frames_max.unit: frames: a thing that comes or goes in this many frames or fewer, outside a planned cut, is a pop
page_timing.layout.pop_frames_max.source: Design (log 35) page pose sampler: any change completed in under 3 frames that is not a planned cut (log 27's one-frame faults: the scissors' jump, the padlock's glow switching on); lesson 86

page_timing.layout.pop_strength_change.unit: change in strength (0 to 1) that counts as coming or going

page_timing.layout.hold_without_still_ke.unit: frames of a held camera with no still key before it is reported
page_timing.layout.hold_without_still_ke.source: check_page_layout.mjs; a held shot without a still key draws the whole set every frame, about 5 times slower (design, log 35; filming.seconds_per_frame_* measured 0.9 s held against 4.3 s sliding)

page_timing.layout.camera_still_toleranc.unit: metres (and quaternion parts) a camera may differ between frames and still count as holding
page_timing.layout.camera_still_toleranc.source: check_page_layout.mjs (page_events.mjs rounds the camera to 0.0001 m)

page_timing.layout.jump_pixels_min.unit: pixels a drawn thing's middle may move in one frame before it counts as a jump
page_timing.layout.jump_pixels_min.source: check_page_layout.mjs; log 27's one-frame faults (the scissors' jump). Judged on what shows: a label whose words have not come in yet does not count

page_timing.overlap_opacity_min.unit: strength (0 to 1) both lines must have to count as overlapping
page_timing.overlap_opacity_min.source: Design (log 35) overlay lint: two text boxes overlapping with both alpha above 0.1

page_timing.overlap_pixels_min.unit: pixels two boxes must overlap by, across and down
page_timing.overlap_pixels_min.source: plan_page_timing.py and check_page_layout.mjs: ignores boxes that only touch
